data.title: 玛露希尔 · 蘑菇图鉴的争论
data.description: 营地，她摊着手绘的蘑菇图鉴与同伴争论某种菌类的可食性，手指点着插图据理力争；最后以「吃了看看就知道了（不是我吃）」收场。
data.action: 营地，她摊着手绘的蘑菇图鉴与同伴争论某种菌类的可食性，手指点着插图据理力争
data.promptProse: Marcille Donato argues a mushroom's edibility with her camp companion, pointing firmly at its drawing in her field notebook. Her blue travel robe and neat blonde braids reflect the serious research, green eyes raised toward the listener. A closed sample pouch remains beside the book; nobody tastes it. Lantern light illuminates the illustration and their working area in the medium view, with page shadows under her fingertip and darker camp gear behind.
